incidents.name: EtnProduct Umarket saleU payout
incidents.notes: The Umarket contract's saleU() paid out USDT for U tokens the attacker had obtained for free by registering a product through Etnshop/EtnProduct and burning LP into the pair, because saleU() never validated how the U balance was acquired.

sources.ref: onchain review: Umarket 0xc0e8D30D2ead2C324b3f1A8386992Ba1Be534CbF created 2022-07-20T15:02:01Z by 0xa3601967b0c3180b7c2631638dea69eafa956475, unrelated to attack sender 0xde703797fe9219b0485fb31eda627aa182b1601e; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 11,253.73 USDT left Umarket in the exploit transaction and the attacker EOA netted 3,074.53 USDT after repaying the DODO flash loan; lossUsd records the reported net 3,074 USD.
